setting.Title: PAP alarm activations per area and hour
setting.Query:
WITH w0 AS (SELECT DATEADD(hour, 1 + DATEDIFF(hour, 0, COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@End')), ''), 120), GETDATE())), 0) AS NowTs,
 DATEADD(hour, DATEDIFF(hour, 0, TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@Start')), ''), 120)), 0) AS S1),
w1 AS (SELECT NowTs, CASE WHEN S1 IS NULL OR S1 >= NowTs THEN DATEADD(hour, -24, NowTs) WHEN S1 < DATEADD(day, -31, NowTs) THEN DATEADD(day, -31, NowTs) ELSE S1 END AS StartTs FROM w0),
w AS (SELECT NowTs, StartTs, CAST(CAST(StartTs AS date) AS datetime) AS D0 FROM w1),
h0 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(hour, w.StartTs, w.NowTs) > 168 THEN DATEADD(hour, -168, w.NowTs) ELSE w.StartTs END AS HStart, w.NowTs FROM w),
hrs AS (SELECT TOP (168) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1 AS HourNo FROM sys.all_objects),
grp AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (0,'Train A'),(1,'Train B'),(2,'Train C'),(3,'Common'),(4,'Raw Material'),(5,'Cooling Tower'),(6,'Concentrate'),(7,'Utilities'),(8,'Control Building 1'),(9,'Control Building 2'),(10,'Unassigned')) v(Area, Area_name)),
cnt AS (SELECT DATEDIFF(hour, h0.HStart, t.[TimeStamp]) AS HourNo, ga.Area, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM (SELECT y.*, ISNULL(am.AreaCode, '') AS [AreaCode] FROM dbo.[_Maaden_DCS_ProcessAlarms_1] y WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.Src, z.AreaCode FROM (SELECT DISTINCT y2.[Source] AS Src FROM dbo.[_Maaden_DCS_ProcessAlarms_1] y2 WITH (NOLOCK) CROSS JOIN h0 WHERE y2.[TimeStamp] >= h0.HStart AND y2.[TimeStamp] < h0.NowTs) d CROSS APPLY (SELECT UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Src))) AS S) sx OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 m.c AS AreaCode FROM (VALUES ('3A10'),('3A20'),('3A30'),('3A3A'),('3A3B'),('3A40'),('3A50'),('3A5A'),('3A5B'),('3A5C'),('3A5D'),('3A60'),('3A70'),('3A80'),('3A90'),('3B10'),('3B20'),('3B30'),('3B3A'),('3B3B'),('3B40'),('3B50'),('3B5A'),('3B5B'),('3B5C'),('3B5D'),('3B60'),('3B70'),('3B80'),('3B90'),('3C10'),('3C20'),('3C30'),('3C3A'),('3C3B'),('3C40'),('3C50'),('3C5A'),('3C5B'),('3C5C'),('3C5D'),('3C60'),('3C70'),('3C80'),('3C90'),('07ZZ'),('09AA'),('09EA'),('09WF'),('09WG'),('09WL'),('09WR'),('09YF'),('1A11'),('1A61'),('2A22'),('2B22'),('2C22'),('3AEV'),('3FGS'),('72D0'),('72V0'),('8NY0'),('8P00'),('3000'),('30DD'),('3130'),('3120'),('3115'),('3110'),('3210'),('3420'),('39MA'),('39WG'),('3JDD'),('3KDD')) m(c) WHERE CHARINDEX(m.c, sx.S) > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(sx.S, 2, 4) = m.c THEN 0 WHEN LEFT(sx.S, 4) = m.c THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CHARINDEX(m.c, sx.S)) z) am ON am.Src = y.[Source]) t CROSS JOIN h0 CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('3A10','3A20','3A30','3A3A','3A3B','3A40','3A50','3A5A','3A5B','3A5C','3A5D','3A60','3A70','3A80','3A90') THEN 0 WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('3B10','3B20','3B30','3B3A','3B3B','3B40','3B50','3B5A','3B5B','3B5C','3B5D','3B60','3B70','3B80','3B90') THEN 1 WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('3C10','3C20','3C30','3C3A','3C3B','3C40','3C50','3C5A','3C5B','3C5C','3C5D','3C60','3C70','3C80','3C90') THEN 2 WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('07ZZ','09AA','09EA','09WF','09WG','09WL','09WR','09YF','1A11','1A61','2A22','2B22','2C22','3AEV','3FGS','72D0','72V0','8NY0','8P00','3000','30DD') THEN 3 WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('3130','3120','3115','3110') THEN 4 WHEN t.[AreaCode] = '3210' THEN 5 WHEN t.[AreaCode] = '3420' THEN 6 WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('39MA','39WG') THEN 7 WHEN t.[AreaCode] = '3JDD' THEN 8 WHEN t.[AreaCode] = '3KDD' THEN 9 ELSE 10 END AS Area) ga
WHERE t.[TimeStamp] >= h0.HStart AND t.[TimeStamp] < h0.NowTs AND t.[Condition] <> '' AND t.[ActiveState] = 'ACTIVE' AND t.[AckRequired] = 'ACKREQD' AND ISNULL(t.[Priority], '') <> 'Logging'
GROUP BY DATEDIFF(hour, h0.HStart, t.[TimeStamp]), ga.Area)
SELECT DAY(DATEADD(hour, h.HourNo, h0.HStart)) * 100 + DATEPART(hour, DATEADD(hour, h.HourNo, h0.HStart)) AS [Hour],
g.Area, ISNULL(c.n, 0) AS Activations,
CONVERT(char(16), DATEADD(hour, h.HourNo, h0.HStart), 120) AS Hour_start, g.Area_name
FROM hrs h CROSS JOIN h0 CROSS JOIN grp g
LEFT HASH JOIN cnt c ON c.HourNo = h.HourNo AND c.Area = g.Area
WHERE DATEADD(hour, h.HourNo, h0.HStart) < h0.NowTs
ORDER BY h.HourNo, g.Area

setting.Query:
WITH p AS (SELECT TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF('@HourStart', ''), 120) AS Hs)
SELECT t.[AreaCode] AS Area_code, COUNT(*) AS Activations, COUNT(DISTINCT t.[Source]) AS Tags
FROM (SELECT y.*, ISNULL(am.AreaCode, '') AS [AreaCode] FROM dbo.[_Maaden_DCS_ProcessAlarms_1] y WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.Src, z.AreaCode FROM (SELECT DISTINCT y2.[Source] AS Src FROM dbo.[_Maaden_DCS_ProcessAlarms_1] y2 WITH (NOLOCK) CROSS JOIN p WHERE y2.[TimeStamp] >= p.Hs AND y2.[TimeStamp] < DATEADD(hour, 1, p.Hs)) d CROSS APPLY (SELECT UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Src))) AS S) sx OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 m.c AS AreaCode FROM (VALUES ('3A10'),('3A20'),('3A30'),('3A3A'),('3A3B'),('3A40'),('3A50'),('3A5A'),('3A5B'),('3A5C'),('3A5D'),('3A60'),('3A70'),('3A80'),('3A90'),('3B10'),('3B20'),('3B30'),('3B3A'),('3B3B'),('3B40'),('3B50'),('3B5A'),('3B5B'),('3B5C'),('3B5D'),('3B60'),('3B70'),('3B80'),('3B90'),('3C10'),('3C20'),('3C30'),('3C3A'),('3C3B'),('3C40'),('3C50'),('3C5A'),('3C5B'),('3C5C'),('3C5D'),('3C60'),('3C70'),('3C80'),('3C90'),('07ZZ'),('09AA'),('09EA'),('09WF'),('09WG'),('09WL'),('09WR'),('09YF'),('1A11'),('1A61'),('2A22'),('2B22'),('2C22'),('3AEV'),('3FGS'),('72D0'),('72V0'),('8NY0'),('8P00'),('3000'),('30DD'),('3130'),('3120'),('3115'),('3110'),('3210'),('3420'),('39MA'),('39WG'),('3JDD'),('3KDD')) m(c) WHERE CHARINDEX(m.c, sx.S) > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(sx.S, 2, 4) = m.c THEN 0 WHEN LEFT(sx.S, 4) = m.c THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CHARINDEX(m.c, sx.S)) z) am ON am.Src = y.[Source]) t CROSS JOIN p
WHERE t.[TimeStamp] >= p.Hs AND t.[TimeStamp] < DATEADD(hour, 1, p.Hs) AND t.[Condition] <> '' AND t.[ActiveState] = 'ACTIVE' AND t.[AckRequired] = 'ACKREQD' AND ISNULL(t.[Priority], '') <> 'Logging' AND CASE WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('3A10','3A20','3A30','3A3A','3A3B','3A40','3A50','3A5A','3A5B','3A5C','3A5D','3A60','3A70','3A80','3A90') THEN 0 WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('3B10','3B20','3B30','3B3A','3B3B','3B40','3B50','3B5A','3B5B','3B5C','3B5D','3B60','3B70','3B80','3B90') THEN 1 WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('3C10','3C20','3C30','3C3A','3C3B','3C40','3C50','3C5A','3C5B','3C5C','3C5D','3C60','3C70','3C80','3C90') THEN 2 WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('07ZZ','09AA','09EA','09WF','09WG','09WL','09WR','09YF','1A11','1A61','2A22','2B22','2C22','3AEV','3FGS','72D0','72V0','8NY0','8P00','3000','30DD') THEN 3 WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('3130','3120','3115','3110') THEN 4 WHEN t.[AreaCode] = '3210' THEN 5 WHEN t.[AreaCode] = '3420' THEN 6 WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('39MA','39WG') THEN 7 WHEN t.[AreaCode] = '3JDD' THEN 8 WHEN t.[AreaCode] = '3KDD' THEN 9 ELSE 10 END = TRY_CAST(NULLIF('@Area', '') AS int)
GROUP BY t.[AreaCode]
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

setting.Query:
WITH p AS (SELECT TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF('@HourStart', ''), 120) AS Hs)
SELECT CONVERT(char(8), t.[TimeStamp], 108) AS [Time], t.[Source] AS Tag, t.[Condition] AS Condition, t.[AreaCode] AS Area_code, t.[Priority] AS Priority, t.[Description] AS Description
FROM (SELECT y.*, ISNULL(am.AreaCode, '') AS [AreaCode] FROM dbo.[_Maaden_DCS_ProcessAlarms_1] y WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.Src, z.AreaCode FROM (SELECT DISTINCT y2.[Source] AS Src FROM dbo.[_Maaden_DCS_ProcessAlarms_1] y2 WITH (NOLOCK) CROSS JOIN p WHERE y2.[TimeStamp] >= p.Hs AND y2.[TimeStamp] < DATEADD(hour, 1, p.Hs)) d CROSS APPLY (SELECT UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Src))) AS S) sx OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 m.c AS AreaCode FROM (VALUES ('3A10'),('3A20'),('3A30'),('3A3A'),('3A3B'),('3A40'),('3A50'),('3A5A'),('3A5B'),('3A5C'),('3A5D'),('3A60'),('3A70'),('3A80'),('3A90'),('3B10'),('3B20'),('3B30'),('3B3A'),('3B3B'),('3B40'),('3B50'),('3B5A'),('3B5B'),('3B5C'),('3B5D'),('3B60'),('3B70'),('3B80'),('3B90'),('3C10'),('3C20'),('3C30'),('3C3A'),('3C3B'),('3C40'),('3C50'),('3C5A'),('3C5B'),('3C5C'),('3C5D'),('3C60'),('3C70'),('3C80'),('3C90'),('07ZZ'),('09AA'),('09EA'),('09WF'),('09WG'),('09WL'),('09WR'),('09YF'),('1A11'),('1A61'),('2A22'),('2B22'),('2C22'),('3AEV'),('3FGS'),('72D0'),('72V0'),('8NY0'),('8P00'),('3000'),('30DD'),('3130'),('3120'),('3115'),('3110'),('3210'),('3420'),('39MA'),('39WG'),('3JDD'),('3KDD')) m(c) WHERE CHARINDEX(m.c, sx.S) > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(sx.S, 2, 4) = m.c THEN 0 WHEN LEFT(sx.S, 4) = m.c THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CHARINDEX(m.c, sx.S)) z) am ON am.Src = y.[Source]) t CROSS JOIN p
WHERE t.[TimeStamp] >= p.Hs AND t.[TimeStamp] < DATEADD(hour, 1, p.Hs) AND t.[Condition] <> '' AND t.[ActiveState] = 'ACTIVE' AND t.[AckRequired] = 'ACKREQD' AND ISNULL(t.[Priority], '') <> 'Logging' AND CASE WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('3A10','3A20','3A30','3A3A','3A3B','3A40','3A50','3A5A','3A5B','3A5C','3A5D','3A60','3A70','3A80','3A90') THEN 0 WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('3B10','3B20','3B30','3B3A','3B3B','3B40','3B50','3B5A','3B5B','3B5C','3B5D','3B60','3B70','3B80','3B90') THEN 1 WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('3C10','3C20','3C30','3C3A','3C3B','3C40','3C50','3C5A','3C5B','3C5C','3C5D','3C60','3C70','3C80','3C90') THEN 2 WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('07ZZ','09AA','09EA','09WF','09WG','09WL','09WR','09YF','1A11','1A61','2A22','2B22','2C22','3AEV','3FGS','72D0','72V0','8NY0','8P00','3000','30DD') THEN 3 WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('3130','3120','3115','3110') THEN 4 WHEN t.[AreaCode] = '3210' THEN 5 WHEN t.[AreaCode] = '3420' THEN 6 WHEN t.[AreaCode] IN ('39MA','39WG') THEN 7 WHEN t.[AreaCode] = '3JDD' THEN 8 WHEN t.[AreaCode] = '3KDD' THEN 9 ELSE 10 END = TRY_CAST(NULLIF('@Area', '') AS int)
ORDER BY t.[TimeStamp], t.[ID]
